# Fixtures for `cue` (CUE sheet)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. Titles, artists,
paths and hosts (Saltmere Brass Band, Mira Castell, Ben Gull, `*.example`) are fictitious; the
media behind any manifest were a few seconds of a test pattern and a sine tone, and are not kept.
Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/subtitles.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `disc-image-crafted.cue` | Written by `scripts/fixtures/craft_subtitles.py`: a data track and audio tracks of a disc image | CC0-1.0 |
| `harbour-suite-metaflac.cue` | metaflac 1.5.0 (`--export-cuesheet-to`, from a cue sheet imported by flac 1.5.0) | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-of-saltmere-crafted.cue` | Written by `scripts/fixtures/craft_subtitles.py`: REM fields, catalogue number, ISRCs, a pre-gap index | CC0-1.0 |
